shellCommands.command: head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; echo ----; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; echo ----; ls src; cat src/*; cat index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>&1; ls __agent_eval__
npm install @gravity-ui/uikit 2>&1 | tail -15; node -p "require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs && ls components guides | head -80; grep -n -i -B2 -A25 "required setup\|ThemeProvider" ../../README.md | head -80; ls components/TextInput* components/Checkbox* components/Card* 2>&1
.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit TextInput Checkbox Button ThemeProvider Card Text Flex 2>&1 | head -40

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls build/docs/components/controls; grep -n -i -A25 "required setup\|## Usage\|Getting started" README.md | head -60; cd build/docs/components; sed -n 1,200p controls/TextInput.md | grep -n -i "type\|label\|validation\|errorMessage\|startContent\|endContent\|autoComplete\|size\|hasClear" | head -40; grep -n -i "content\|checked\|onUpdate\|size" Checkbox.md | head -20; grep -n -i "type\|loading\|width\|view\|size" Button.md | head -30; grep -n -i "view\|spacing\|type\|size" Card.md | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && sed -n 1,60p build/docs/components/controls/PasswordInput.md | cut -c1-220; grep -rn "ThemeProvider" build/docs/INDEX.md | head -5; grep -n "width\|type\|loading" build/docs/components/Button.md | sed -n 1,30p | cut -c1-200; ls build/esm/components/ThemeProvider 2>/dev/null; grep -n "theme\|scoped\|rootClassName" build/esm/components/ThemeProvider/ThemeProvider.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && f=$(find build -name "ThemeProvider.d.ts" | head -1); echo $f; cat $f | head -30; sed -n 186,200p build/docs/components/Button.md | cut -c1-160; grep -n "TextInput\|PasswordInput" build/docs/INDEX.md | head -3
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && grep -n "SpacingValue" -r build/esm --include=*.d.ts | head -3; grep -n -i "gap=" build/docs/guides/layout.md | head -5
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && sed -i 's/gap={5}/gap="spacing-5"/; s/gap={4}/gap="spacing-4"/' src/App.tsx && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15; git status --short
